about_the_game:
Symphorix redefines the bullet hell experience by blending soothing, ambient aesthetics with deep, strategic roguelite mechanics. In this universe, it's not about frantic reactions or memorizing every beat – the music unfolds naturally, guiding you through an immersive soundscape filled with mesmerizing tracks.

  • Ambient, Music-Infused Strategy: In Symphorix, the song plays out as it will. Instead of racing against time, your focus is on pre-planning the perfect build. Imagine knowing that the c# notes dominate your track – your task is to configure your Core to unleash a barrage of missiles at those moments, without having to chase every beat.

  • Relaxed Intensity & Deep Customization: Enjoy a gameplay experience that marries the serenity of ambient music with the depth of a survivorlike roguelite. Customize your Core’s nodes and assign distinct attack types to specific musical notes, letting you shape the battlefield before the chaos even begins.

  • Procedurally Generated, Yet Predictable by Design: While the enemies and bosses emerge from the music’s natural rhythm, their patterns are set by the song’s structure. This means you can study the frequency of key notes – like the recurring c# – and tailor your strategy accordingly.

  • Evolving Tactics & Synergies: Discover powerful combinations and synergies as your Core’s abilities interact with the musical landscape. With each track, the game invites you to premeditate your moves, turning the experience into a thoughtful, methodical dance of strategy and anticipation.

  • Custom Tracks & Live Mode: With over 150 original tracks or the option to import your own MP3s, every run offers a unique ambient journey. The game transforms your chosen music into a dynamic, interactive canvas where planning and creativity pave the way to survival.

  • Core Configuration & Pre-Planning: Before the battle begins, design your Core by assigning notes to its nodes. Whether you choose explosive projectiles or focused beams, the decision is yours – and it’s based on understanding your song's structure, not reacting to each beat.

  • Serene Yet Challenging Encounters: Face off against procedurally generated enemies and uniquely crafted bosses whose behaviors mirror the flow of the music. Every encounter is a testament to your strategic foresight rather than reflex-driven chaos.

  • Progressive, Rewarding Gameplay: Earn upgrades and unlock new abilities as you progress, further refining your build for each song. The challenge is to anticipate, adapt, and create a Core that perfectly aligns with the musical journey.

Step into a world where the music is both a backdrop and a blueprint. In Symphorix, every track is a canvas for your strategic genius – a place where you craft your destiny through thoughtful preparation and tactical precision. Embrace the ambient beauty, plan your moves, and let the music guide you to victory.

STRATEGIZE YOUR CORE. EMBRACE THE AMBIENCE. MASTER SYMPHORIX!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7/8/10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 (2 GB) or AMD Radeon HD 7770 (2 GB) (DirectX 11 compatible GPU)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: While it’s primarily a 2D game, it does use VFX Graph-based effects and simple 3D meshes, so a dedicated GPU is highly recommended over integrated graphics. The game is music-based, so a decent sound setup (headphones or speakers) is recommended for the best experience.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit) or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600 (or newer) / AMD Ryzen 5 1400 (or newer)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (3 GB) or AMD Radeon RX 580 (4 GB) (DirectX 11/12 compatible GPU)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Because the game uses extensive particle effects and real-time VFX, a mid-range GPU will ensure smoother performance. For optimal audio fidelity in a music-centric game, consider higher-quality sound gear and updated drivers.

short_description: Symphorix is a survivorlike roguelite that blends ambient music with strategic pre-planning. Customize your Core, harness recurring musical cues, and shape your defenses to overcome challenging bullet-hell waves. Let the music be your guide.
